title: Reliable Neural Collapse Approximation for Open-World Test-Time Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2608.19890v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) methods aim to bridge the domain gap between the source and target domains. However, traditional TTA methods become ineffective when the label distribution shift occurs, a challenge commonly referred to as an open-world scenario. In this paper, we introduce a new method named Reliable Neural Collapse approximation (ReNC) for Open-World Test-Time Adaptation (OWTTA). Specifically, we leverage neural collapse as a structural prior for reliable target-domain adaptation. Guided by this prior, we justify that the pre-trained classifier weights can serve as the prototypes of the source domain. By measuring the similarity between samples and prototypes, we filter out the Out-Of-Distribution~(OOD) samples for reliable updates. Furthermore, we propose a neural collapse approximation mechanism to refine these prototypes, ensuring they can gradually adapt to the target domain while maintaining the neural collapse structure

translated_title: 面向开放世界测试时自适应的可靠神经坍缩近似方法
translated_abstract: 测试时自适应（TTA）方法旨在弥合源域和目标域之间的域差距。然而，当标签分布偏移发生时，传统的TTA方法变得无效，这一挑战通常被称为开放世界场景。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为可靠神经坍缩近似（ReNC）的新方法，用于开放世界测试时自适应（OWTTA）。具体来说，我们利用神经坍缩作为可靠目标域自适应的结构先验。在此先验的指导下，我们证明了预训练分类器权重可以作为源域的原型。通过测量样本与原型之间的相似性，我们过滤掉分布外（OOD）样本，以实现可靠的更新。此外，我们提出了一种神经坍缩近似机制来细化这些原型，确保它们能够在保持神经坍缩结构的同时逐步适应目标域。
tldr: 本文提出ReNC方法，利用神经坍缩作为结构先验，通过原型过滤OOD样本并逐步细化，实现开放世界测试时自适应的可靠更新。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ReNC, which leverages neural collapse as a structural prior to filter OOD samples via prototypes and refine them progressively, enabling reliable updates for open-world test-time adaptation.
